description: ClickHouse's spec marks no response member required, so ByocConfig.id is optional, and a caller must handle a createByocInfrastructure answer without the new infrastructure's ID. ClickHouse's Terraform provider (ClickHouse/terraform-provider-clickhouse at 66ecf4fa, internal/api) decodes the create response's `id` and at once waits on and reads the infrastructure by it. No live create was made: the test organization is not a BYOC organization. Marking ByocConfig.id required lets callers read the ID without checking for undefined.
